correctness.rationale: The zero-indexed 2-adic valuation definition is equivalent to the fold recursion and yields an exact 8-symbol block [a,b,1-a,x,a,1-b,1-a,y]. All relevant input states and both values of each parameter satisfy the explicitly checked arch transition table (48 state cases). If a differs from b every block contributes 3 arches; otherwise the state correction telescopes to one bit of the last block, which equals instruction d_k. The standard greedy arch lemma proves universal-subsequence equality, and elementary 2/8 counting proves the fraction. Independent representations and exhaustive instruction choices through k=10 plus larger samples verify finite cases; proof, not samples, supports all k and uncomputable instructions.

value.rationale: The all-stream theorem evaluates a natural and widely studied scattered-subsequence universality invariant for every generalized paperfolding word at every dyadic scale, with exact instruction-conditional one-unit defect, frequency 1/4 among instruction prefixes, and an instruction-independent asymptotic density 3/8. The 8-block finite-state cancellation is a structural phenomenon and supplies a reproducible formula beyond generic algorithms or isolated finite tables. It does not assert any nondyadic classification.
